HOW TO PLAY

Rotate the rings. Every beam fires straight through the center. Light every LOCK at once to breach.

// CONTROLS

▲▼ select ring ◀▶ rotate selected ring Drag a ring's track directly Esc pause Gamepad D-pad / stick + A
Tip: click any ring's track to select it, then drag left/right to rotate — or use the arrow keys.

// FIELD LEGEND

◉
SourceFires a beam straight through the center of the ring it's on.
╲
MirrorTurns another ring's beam exactly 90°, at any slot. ╲ turns it clockwise, ╱ turns it counter-clockwise.
⬤
BlockDestroys another ring's beam outright. Never its own.
▲
AmplifierBoosts another ring's beam to STRONG, letting it punch through other rings' sources.
◎
Portal (Black Hole)Holes come in a linked pair. Each hole is TWO nodes long: a beam touching it anywhere along its whole length, from ANY direction, is absorbed. It then comes out of the OTHER hole, always travelling in that hole’s own fixed exit direction (where its black mouth points) — never the direction the beam came in on. Two holes in a level can point different ways.
◐
Half-BlockOne-way valve — stops another ring's beam from ONE direction (in or out) only.
△
PrismSplits another ring's beam into two, bent ±45° off its original heading.
⛯
Rim Emitter (Challenge)A source bolted to the rim. It never turns and fires straight at the center. In Challenge, it is the only beam, there is one Lock (the gift lock), and exactly one way to turn the four rings so the beam reaches it.
◍
Echo (Satellite)Always pinned in place. Its DISH shows which way it fires, and it is built pointing UP, DOWN, LEFT or RIGHT depending on the level. A beam that arrives from the DISH side (within 45° of the dish axis) dies there. A beam that arrives from either SIDE or from the ENGINE end (below) is absorbed and relaunched straight out of the DISH.
◎
LockNeeds a beam landing on it. ALL Locks must be lit at once to breach the level.
☆
Bonus LockOptional — light it too, at the same time as every Lock, for a bonus coin. Never required.

// ☄ SPECIAL MODE — METEOR ATTACK

☄
Meteor Lock DestructionEvery Special Mode level has 6 coin Locks. Every 10 seconds a meteor picks one at complete random and destroys it — gone for good, whether it was lit or dark. Being lit does NOT protect a Lock. Nothing about rings, beams, or gimmicks changes; the clock only takes away targets. The run always ends in a win — the instant every surviving Lock is lit at once, it's over. The goal is having as many lit as possible when that happens.

// 🚀 ROCKET ATTACK — LAST TOUCH & GIFT, LIGHT, ELECTRICITY LOCKS

🚀
Rockets hit where a beam ENDSEvery 5 seconds the boss UFO fires a rocket at the last thing each beam touches: the Lock it lands on, or the Block / Half-Block / Satellite that stops it. 10 seconds later that target is destroyed. Things a beam only passes through (Mirror, Amplifier, Prism, Black Holes) are never targeted, and a beam that ends on empty rim glass is safe.
🎁
Gift LocksEvery Lock is a gift lock. Light every surviving one at the same moment to clear the level. Each Lock lit at the clear is banked once, and every 4 banked Locks opens a gift box. A Lock a rocket destroys is gone for that attempt.
💡
Light LocksEach one lights an equal share of the board (2 Light Locks = half each, 4 = a quarter each). If a rocket destroys one, its share goes dark and only your beams still light what they touch there.
⚡
Electricity LocksOne per ring; the small number shows which ring it powers. If a rocket destroys it, that ring loses power and can't be turned again this attempt.
✓
You can't loseWhatever gets hit, the level always finishes. If the damage means not every gift lock can be lit together any more, it clears the moment you light as many as are still possible. RESET restores everything.

// ✦ SPACE ORCHESTRA — FOG, GRAY UFOS & GIFT LOCKS

🌫️
FogEvery Lock in Space Orchestra starts fogged. A fogged Lock is a physical wall — a beam that reaches it is blocked there, no matter how correctly the rings are set, and its true state stays hidden.
🛸
One UFO per LockEach fogged Lock has its own numbered gray UFO. Route any beam onto UFO 1 and it's knocked out for 10 seconds — Lock 1's fog lifts while it's down, then the UFO rises again and the fog comes back. UFO 2 does the same for Lock 2, and so on, so knock out every UFO you need and light their Locks before they get back up. A beam left sitting on a UFO won't knock it out again; it has to newly reach it. The UFOs leave one by one — UFO 1 at 0:30, UFO 2 at 1:30, UFO 3 at 2:30, UFO 4 at 4:00 — and a Lock whose UFO escaped stays fogged, so reset and try again.
🎁
Gift LocksEvery Lock in Space Orchestra is a gift lock. Each Lock you light when you clear a movement is banked (once per Lock), and every 4 banked Locks opens a gift box: two beam colors, then a rim, then a theme, and the cycle repeats.
Find this again anytime from Options.
